mainEntity.name: What does a token launch PR program actually cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: A token launch PR program covers five sequential workstreams. One: pre-TGE positioning — a category word, a thesis the trade press can run with, and a three-sentence pitch that is not about price. Two: embargo coordination — a single tier-1 anchor (CoinDesk, The Block, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, Blockworks) plus four to eight secondary outlets aligned to one launch window. Three: exchange communications — coordinated announcements with Binance, OKX, MEXC, Bybit, KuCoin, Bitget and Gate listings desks where applicable. Four: KOL waves — segmented activation across 200+ vetted Twitter, YouTube and Telegram creators in the right order for news desks to amplify. Five: post-TGE sustained coverage — founder profile, op-ed cycle, regional re-syndication and sentiment plus AI-citation tracking for the 30 to 90 days after the token goes live.

mainEntity.name: When should a token founder hire a PR consultant before TGE?

acceptedAnswer.text: Six to twelve weeks before TGE is the right window for a focused sprint. Eight weeks is the standard run-up published in 2026 launch playbooks — long enough to publish two to three substantive earned stories per week, build the journalist relationships that get an exclusive, and stage the embargo. Founders with a longer runway (four to six months) get the strongest result because pre-TGE PR is sequencing work — narrative research, community build, content and KOL activation each compound. Hiring inside three weeks of TGE still works for embargo coordination and KOL waves but cuts off positioning and journalist build, which is where most of the long-tail coverage comes from.

mainEntity.name: How much does token launch PR cost in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional pre-TGE retainer runs $6,000 to $14,000 per month over a three to six month engagement. A focused TGE launch sprint over six to ten weeks (positioning, embargo, launch day, immediate post-TGE coverage) runs $20,000 to $60,000 total. A full pre-TGE through post-listing program with exchange comms, multi-region KOL waves and a 90-day sustained coverage tail runs $45,000 to $120,000. Traditional Web3 PR agency retainers for the same scope are commonly $15,000 to $30,000 per month — funding a multi-person account team. The fractional model removes that layer; one senior operator works directly with the founder.

mainEntity.name: Does token launch PR cover exchange listings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Exchange listing communications is a core workstream and is timed against the TGE itself. The scope covers: pre-listing intro briefs to Binance, OKX, MEXC, Bybit, KuCoin, Bitget and Gate listings and content desks; coordinated announcement timing so the listing news lands inside the TGE window rather than fragmenting attention; sponsored content alignment with the exchange's research and education arms where appropriate; and post-listing sentiment monitoring across Twitter, Telegram and the major crypto news desks. Exchange listings without coordinated comms typically waste the launch news cycle; coordinated launches compound.

mainEntity.name: How are KOL waves coordinated during a token launch?

acceptedAnswer.text: KOL waves are run in three segmented passes timed against the launch day. Wave one (T-72 hours to T-0) is a small group of credibility-anchor creators — research-style Twitter accounts, founder voices, ecosystem analysts — who post substantive primers ahead of the news. Wave two (T+0 to T+8 hours) is the broad activation: 40 to 120 vetted creators reacting to the launch, segmented by region (US, KR, JP, VN, IN, MENA) and audience quality. Wave three (T+24 hours to T+7 days) is sustained: video creators on YouTube, podcast guest spots, deep-dive Twitter threads that keep the narrative alive past the news cycle. All three waves are coordinated against the tier-1 placements so news desks see KOL conversation building around the same story they are reading.

mainEntity.name: What does compliance-aware token launch PR mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compliance-aware token launch PR means the communications never lead with price, never project token value, never use language a regulator would read as solicitation, and never frame the token as an investment. The pitch leads with utility — what the network does, who it is for, why now. Founder quotes are reviewed against the same standard. Embargo emails to journalists do not include price or projections. KOL briefs are written so disclosure-compliant creators can run them without rewriting. This protects the founder, the project and the journalist relationship — and in 2026 it is also what tier-1 desks require before they will run an embargo at all.

mainEntity.name: How does token launch PR work for a Korea TGE in 2026 (FSC, DABA, Upbit and Bithumb listings, KBW)?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Korea-anchored TGE in 2026 leads with the Upbit, Bithumb, Coinone, Korbit or Gopax listing answer in the first paragraph because that is the question every Korean trade desk asks. Press copy carries the FSC five-minute reconciliation note, the zero-threshold Travel Rule line, and the Digital Asset Basic Act (DABA) compliance status. The pre-TGE press cycle is BloomingBit, TokenPost, BlockMedia, Coinness and CoinReaders. Korean retail moves through Telegram, Naver cafes and the KakaoTalk closed-channel layer; the KOL wave is timed to embargo lift at 10 AM KST and never leads with price. The Korea Blockchain Week 2026 window (September 22 to 28, Impact at COEX) is the highest-leverage TGE press cycle of the year. Quarterly retainer $6K to $14K per month, single-market sprint $12K to $35K.

mainEntity.name: How does token launch PR work for a Japan TGE in 2026 (FIEA reclassification, FSA, JVCEA, bitFlyer and Coincheck)?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Japan TGE in 2026 runs against the April 2026 Cabinet-approved FIEA reclassification of 105 crypto assets including BTC and ETH as financial instruments, plus the JVCEA white-list and FSA registration requirements that gate every bitFlyer, Coincheck, Bitbank and SBI VC Trade listing. Japanese trade desks (CoinPost, CoinDesk Japan, Cointelegraph Japan, CryptoTimes JP, Iolite) want a named-partner credibility anchor and a clean data table, not a hero-narrative pitch. No investment-framing language post-FIEA shift. WebX 2026 (July 13 to 14, The Prince Park Tower Tokyo) is the standard pre-TGE press window. note.com is the highest-leverage AI-search citation unlock per dollar. LINE Open Chat is the primary closed-community surface. Press copy never projects price.

mainEntity.name: How does token launch PR work for a Singapore TGE in 2026 (MAS, DPT licensing, Project Guardian, Token2049)?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Singapore TGE in 2026 leads with MAS licensing status (DPT licence, exemption status, or Project Guardian participation) and the named institutional anchor — BlackRock, JPMorgan, DBS, Citi, HSBC, Standard Chartered or a regional bank. Token2049 Singapore (October, Marina Bay Sands, 20,000-plus attendees) is the regional press cycle anchor and the right stage for a TGE-adjacent reveal. Outlets are e27, Tech in Asia, DealStreetAsia, plus the Token2049 newsroom and tier-1 crypto desks. A generic raise without a Singapore anchor reads as a press blip. The press kit carries three lines: MAS status, Singapore-as-regional-headquarters framing for tax and corporate-structure clarity, and the named local-partner anchor that ties the TGE to the Singapore ecosystem rather than treating Singapore as a generic Asia stop.

mainEntity.name: How does token launch PR work for a Dubai or MENA TGE in 2026 (VARA, ADGM FSRA, RAK DAO, Token2049 Dubai)?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Dubai or MENA TGE in 2026 carries a per-jurisdiction note: VARA for Dubai-licensed operations, ADGM FSRA for Abu Dhabi-domiciled vehicles, RAK DAO for DAO-structured tokenized treasuries. The May 2026 Token2049 Dubai press cycle is the highest-leverage TGE window in the region — the MANTRA $11M raise framed as a Middle East RWA story established the template. Outlets are Arabian Business, Gulf News, The National and Cointelegraph Arabic, plus regional re-reports through CryptoPotato and Decrypt MENA. The press kit requires a UAE or Saudi regulatory tie-in, a named local partner and a Token2049 Dubai stage moment. Saudi PIF and Mubadala lines decide what stage is available. Compliance-aware messaging is non-negotiable; no investment framing for retail-facing copy.

mainEntity.name: How does token launch PR work for an India TGE in 2026 (SEBI, MeitY, CoinDCX, WazirX, ETHIndia)?

acceptedAnswer.text: An India TGE in 2026 runs three press tracks in parallel plus the ETHIndia December press cycle. Mainstream business is Economic Times, Business Today, Forbes India and Mint. Startup-and-VC is Inc42, YourStory and Moneycontrol. Crypto-native is CoinGape, NewsBTC India and HackerNoon for founder interviews. Indian press wants founder country of origin, lead-investor name and SEBI-and-MeitY-adjacent regulatory framing; a Western-style raise pitch without the regulatory acknowledgement gets re-reported with the gap noted. CoinDCX and WazirX listings need their own embargo coordination. The Bullieverse $4M seed was launched as an Economic Times exclusive then run on two parallel tracks (mainstream Indian business plus crypto-native), each with its own framing of the same fact sheet. Indian retail audiences route through X, YouTube and Telegram tri-platform creators.
